prompt.en: In the given figure, sides CB and BA of triangle ABC have been produced to D and E respectively, such that angle ABD = 110 degrees and angle CAE = 135 degrees. Find angle ACB.

diagram.a11yCaption: Triangle ABC with side CB extended to D and side BA extended to E, angle ABD marked 110 degrees and angle CAE marked 135 degrees.

label.en: Uses the linear pair at B to find angle ABC

level1.en: Angle ABD and angle ABC lie on a straight line at B - what do they add up to?

clue.en: Angle ABD and angle ABC form a linear pair, so they add up to 180 degrees.

level2Template.en: Since DBC is a straight line, angle ABC = 180 - 110 = ___ degrees.

label.en: Uses the linear pair at A to find angle BAC

level1.en: Angle CAE and angle BAC lie on a straight line at A - what do they add up to?

clue.en: Angle CAE and angle BAC form a linear pair, so they add up to 180 degrees.

level2Template.en: Since EAB is a straight line, angle BAC = 180 - 135 = ___ degrees.

label.en: Applies the angle sum property of a triangle to find angle ACB

level1.en: The three angles of triangle ABC add up to 180 degrees - use the two you just found.

clue.en: Angle ACB = 180 - angle ABC - angle BAC = 180 - 70 - 45.

level2Template.en: By the angle sum property of a triangle, angle ACB = 180 - 70 - 45 = ___ degrees.
